p: A limestone gorge on the Juma River, marketed as a "little Guilin". Worth a day trip if you have never seen the karst scenery of Guilin, Ha Long Bay or Vang Vieng, though it is a smaller-scale version of them. The name means "tenth…

An activity park rather than a scenic walk, with a cable car, a bungee jump and bamboo rafts for hire. The prices recorded here date from 2013 and are almost certainly out of date: cable car ¥60 return, bungee ¥200, raft ¥60 per hour…
